text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeing Dants Frame looking exhausted,
I decided to take her to the infirmary to rest.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
There's no need to worry.
I'm just going to go rest for a little bit!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
“—And so, that's all for today's class!
If anyone has questions, stick around~”

text_block_list.name: Students
text_block_list.text: Yeees. Goodbye, Teacher Dantsu~

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: "Getting right to the point, do you have a moment? I'd like your thoughts on how to solve this equation."

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: (So many numbers and letters I've never seen before...!)

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Um... let's see, wait just a moment!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
If we don't get it, we just have to work hard!
Let's start from page one of the study guide—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Hmm. Like this, maybe...? Huh? Totally wrong!
Where did I mess up...!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
*Yaaawn*... Ah, no!
I didn't just yawn, nope!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Tachyon-chan!
Sorry to keep you wait—wait, huh?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
They were here until just a bit ago, but they went home.
Said they'd listen to the rest tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Ah, you're right! It's already evening...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"Hear about it? Word is someone's built
a whole mountain of reference books in the library."

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha... It's not like I can do things
like Tachyon-chan does. But—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Because I'm a teacher... no, because you relied on me.
I felt like I had to do my very best in my own way!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
...Heh, I see.
You really are that kind of person.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Hey, help me study later, will ya?!
If it's you, maybe you can actually make me understand this stuff.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Huh?! Me to Pokke-chan?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Damn straight. Who else would it be but you?
I'm countin' on ya—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Prof Dantsu!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
...Of course!
Wait, ah... It was just a dream...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe. Better give it our all!
